notes.title: Update v.0.0.0.2 is now release!
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new weapon "Old Revolver" for backstory "Doctor"
[*] Weapon boxes now appear in some places (along with weapons, they may also contain ammo)
[*] Player’s base has been slightly expanded, some new moves have been added
[*] New Type of Mutant - Poisoned
[*] Added mechanics of the attack of mutants on the player’s base (the size of the attacks depends on the level of infection)
[*] Mutants can destroy buildings on player's base
[*] Player can sell buildings on his base
[*] Added a bed in the player's sector (the ability to sleep if "sleepiness" is more than 60%)
[*] Wardrobe added to player sector
[*] Added 3 types of suits and 3 types of armor(suits provide resistance from various debuffs / armor provides protection against damage)
[*] Added 2D version of the graphics settings menu
[*] Fixed incorrect calculation of days
[*] Сolor of the bubbles of the mutant’s weak spots has been changed from yellow to calmer
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing Update v.0.0.0.2 [Early Access]
notes.content:
In the next update v.0.0.0.2, a wardrobe will appear, and with it three types of suits and three types of armor. Some will give resistance to some kind of debuff, and some will simply increase damage protection.

Also, the player’s base will be slightly expanded, and new moves will appear. + The mechanics of attacking the base will appear. Monsters will be able to destroy your buildings, so be prepared. ;)

The update will be released within a few days.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35601777/37e74864ad72b3f43ff9de18837263d7bde4929a.jpg[/img]
